What crime? Likely "拒不支付劳动报酬罪" (refusal to pay labor remuneration). In Chinese criminal law, article 279? Actually "拒不支付劳动报酬罪" is under the Labor Law. The examples earlier: "拒不支付劳动报酬" was used for case with contractor not paying wages. So answer: 拒不支付劳动报酬.

Thus single crime.
